name: Atrial Appendage Anomaly

criteria.description: Visualization of abnormal morphology or absence of the atrial appendage on echocardiography or cardiac MRI
Presence of atrial arrhythmias or conduction abnormalities on ECG
Symptoms related to atrial dysfunction such as palpitations or thromboembolic events

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Imaging confirmation of atrial appendage anomaly plus at least one clinical or electrocardiographic feature
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis relies heavily on advanced cardiac imaging techniques.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Absent or hypoplastic atrial appendage detected by imaging
searchTerms: missing or small heart atrial appendage seen on scans
absent or underdeveloped atrial pouch

pathognomonic.symptomName: Atrial arrhythmia associated with atrial appendage anomaly
searchTerms: irregular heart rhythm linked to atrial appendage abnormality
atrial arrhythmia with structural heart anomaly

common.symptomName: Palpitations due to atrial conduction abnormalities
searchTerms: heart palpitations from atrial electrical issues
irregular heartbeat due to atrial conduction problems

common.symptomName: Thromboembolic events secondary to atrial appendage dysfunction
searchTerms: blood clots caused by atrial appendage dysfunction
thromboembolism from heart appendage

common.symptomName: Exercise intolerance related to impaired atrial function
searchTerms: poor exercise tolerance due to heart atrial problems
fatigue with activity from atrial dysfunction
mild shortness of breath during activity
slight breathlessness on exertion

occasional.symptomName: Chest discomfort or atypical chest pain
searchTerms: chest discomfort or unusual chest pain
non-typical chest ache
fainting or near fainting spells
passing out episodes
lightheadedness and loss of consciousness

occasional.symptomName: Fatigue related to decreased cardiac output
searchTerms: tiredness from poor heart function
fatigue due to low cardiac output
weakness related to heart problems

occasional.symptomName: Palpitations triggered by stress or exertion
searchTerms: heart palpitations triggered by stress or exercise
racing heart with exertion or anxiety

rare.symptomName: Stroke due to cardioembolic source from atrial appendage anomaly
searchTerms: stroke caused by heart clot from atrial appendage
brain attack due to cardioembolic source

rare.symptomName: Heart failure symptoms secondary to atrial dysfunction
searchTerms: symptoms of heart failure from atrial problems
heart failure signs due to atrial dysfunction

rare.symptomName: Systemic embolism unrelated to other causes
searchTerms: blood clots traveling in body
blockage in blood vessels
embolism without common causes

laboratory: Normal routine blood tests; coagulation profile may be abnormal if thromboembolism present
imaging: Echocardiography showing absent or malformed atrial appendage
Cardiac MRI confirming atrial appendage morphology and function
CT angiography for detailed anatomical assessment
genetic: No specific genetic markers identified; possible sporadic or familial cases
other: Electrocardiogram showing atrial arrhythmias or conduction delays

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of interatrial communication on imaging
Mass lesion within atrium on imaging
No congenital malformation of atrial appendage

redFlags: Sudden onset of stroke or transient ischemic attack
Evidence of systemic embolism without other source
references: Cardiac Imaging in Congenital Heart Disease, Journal of Cardiovascular Imaging, 2023
Arrhythmias Associated with Atrial Appendage Malformations, Heart Rhythm Journal, 2022
